Maya: heads up everyone  lineup lock at midnight. my goalie Teal is starting to look like a human highlight reel (not always good). anyone willing to temp-claim him for tonight? :hockey:
Jonah: i will if theres pizza involved. whats the trade?
Maya: temporary swap for 12h. ill hand over an emergency bench slot + one slice IRL :pizza:
Riley: ill take Teal for tonight. will drop a forward.
Sam: quick poll  react :one: trade, :two: keep and pray, :three: countermelody of curses at the ref
Jonah: :one: from me. pizza please.
PizzaBot: Order queued: 1x large pepperoni pending confirmation if trade completes. confirm: https://pizza.fake/order/abc123
Riley: trade posted: `/fantasy trade @Maya Teal -> Riley --temp 12h`
Maya: trade confirmed on the league site. Riley has Teal, pizza bot blessed. :pray:
Sam: triple OT incoming? who are we betting for the office roast?
Riley: if Teal gets a shutout im embroidering "OT legend" on the office jersey and handing out coffee to the losers.
Jonah: reminder  jersey swap by the lobby shelf at 11 tomorrow. @Riley you bringing the vikings jersey?
Riley: yes. ill bring it and maybe a celebratory bandage if we need it. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Maya: thanks yall. will report back with postgame praise or brutal roast in this channel. stakes: if Teal collapses i owe pizza and a roast, if he shines Riley buys Jonah coffee. game on.
